source.note: Wave-1 row 101 named the Quaternius Goblin (Animated models, misc) on poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Substituted with Goblin_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt (same zip and pin as man-casual and worker). Goblin_Male was chosen over Goblin_Female: bald head, big pointed ears, two lower tusks and a scowl read as a goblin at a glance, while the female's long hair covers the ears and she has no visible fangs, so she reads as a human girl. The source skin is olive green; no colour script has a green, so the skin is painted indigo amber (iris #e7a04a, shaded accent red), which still reads non-human. It ships 11 clips (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit, walk-carry, pick-up, one-handed shoot, victory, defeat, stand-up), not the plan's 7: no run, jump or death.
